text:
maria: Quick heads-up — kicking off a least-privilege sweep across staging + canary today. Goal: evict temporary admin grants, tighten KMS bindings, and capture evidence for the compliance packet. Please confirm owners for any resources you care about by EOD. :eyes:

devon: 👍 can you paste the affected projects/keys?

maria: listed below. short plan: (1) identify temp admin bindings (2) notify owners (3) remove temp bindings in 24h canary (4) monitor logs for 48h and collect evidence. If no owner reply, we'll remove and open a ticket for reinstatement if needed.

jordan: add a safety-net: create a single `recovery-admin@infra` SA with a narrow set of re-elevate runbooks, only usable by two engineers via ticket. keep that SA out of normal admin groups.

maria: agreed. plan includes a recovery SA with explicit audit annotation. we won't grant it full owner; it'll have `roles/iam.securityAdmin` + `roles/kms.admin` for recovery ops, and we record all token usage.

samir: do we have auditable evidence pre-change? compliance needs a list of who used what KMS keys in last 90 days.

maria: yes — BigQuery export has the logs. sample query I used:
```sql
SELECT
  protopayload_auditlog.authenticationInfo.principalEmail AS actor,
  JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(protoPayload.request, '$.name') AS resourceName,
  timestamp
FROM `project.logs.cloudaudit_googleapis_com_activity_*`
WHERE protoPayload.serviceName = 'cloudkms.googleapis.com'
  AND timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 90 DAY)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1000;
```

devon: perfect. can we also show the IAM bindings snapshot?

maria: run this to capture current KMS key IAM policy (for each key):
```bash
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy KEY_NAME --location=LOCATION --keyring=RING --project=PROJECT_ID > key-KEY_NAME-policy.json
```

ops-bot: Reminder: scheduled change window at 2024-11-06T22:00Z — automated rollouts will proceed during the 2-hour window.

jordan: what about cross-project service accounts that have been accidentally granted `roles/editor`? do we include them in the sweep or open separate tickets?

maria: include them. sweep target = any principal with `roles/owner`, `roles/editor`, `roles/iam.serviceAccountAdmin`, or `roles/kms.admin` that was granted transiently (last 30 days) or marked as `temp-*` in binding annotations. We'll open follow-up tickets for infra-owned service accounts.

samir: if we remove a binding and an app breaks, what's rollback?
maria: rollback paths: (A) quick re-add binding with same annotation and open a P0 only if recovery-SA can't recover, (B) use a canary policy that removes 10% first, then ramp. We'll capture `gcloud` commands in the runbook and require a change-owner tag.

devon: can you paste the snippet you'll use to remove a binding? makes testing easier.

maria: sure — example (replace placeholders):
```bash
# remove binding
gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding PROJECT_ID \
  --member='serviceAccount:someone@PROJECT_ID.iam.gserviceaccount.com' \
  --role='roles/editor' \
  --condition=None
```

elenar: also check KMS cryptoKey versions — sometimes people grant admin to manage random versions. we should snapshot `cryptoKeyVersions` usage.

maria: good call. I'm adding a step to export `cryptoKeyVersions` access patterns and map to owners.

jordan: permissioned audit: we should record proof that notices were sent (thread + email). can we automate a DM to owner list with the BQ query link?

maria: yes — I have a small script that posts a Slack DM and attaches the BigQuery link + single-click ack. if no ack in 24h we escalate to oncall.

samir: one more ask — for compliance, include a human-readable CSV of before/after bindings and a signed attestation from change-owner.

maria: will include. adding a checklist to the ticket template now.

devon: i'm +1 on canary rollout. please add me as backup recovery contact.

maria: added. final ask: owners, comment here with `i'm owner: PROJECT_ID` by 18:00 PST or we'll treat it as unowned and proceed with removal. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

elenar: i'm owner: staging-ml-models

devon: i'm owner: staging-catalog

jordan: i'm owner: canary-metrics

samir: i'm owner: staging-payments (will validate KMS bindings)

maria: thanks all. I'll post the remediation runbook and exact change window (UTC) ~ 30m before ops-bot initiates. If anyone spots a risky binding that must stay, DM me the reason + mitigation and we'll pause for that principal. :lock:

ops-bot: Change window locked in: 2024-11-06T22:00Z — channel will be read-only during execution.

maria: closing loop — audit collection path and checklist uploaded to ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-7821 — add comments there for exceptions.

devon: noted. thanks. :thumbsup:
